summary: Enhance your skills in humanitarian work with our training course on protection and rights. Empower yourself to make a difference in vulnerable communities.
lede: Humanitarian protection training covers practical ways to safeguard people affected by crises through rights-based response measures. It is for protection officers, field coordinators and safeguarding teams who assess vulnerabilities and plan services, with practice in risk analysis, secure protection-data handling and referral pathways. Participants also explore how to apply humanitarian and human rights principles, strengthen community feedback, and integrate protection across programs.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for safeguarding vulnerable populations and ensuring compliance with international humanitarian frameworks.
modules: Foundations of Humanitarian Protection and Law
Protection Risk Assessment and Vulnerability Analysis
Protection Information Management and Data Privacy
Specialized Protection Areas: Child Protection and GBV
prerequisites: Participants should have basic working knowledge of humanitarian or development operations. No prior legal expertise in International Humanitarian Law (IHL) is required. Familiarity with basic data collection concepts and community engagement practices is recommended.
